Search by business type and location using your own Google Places API key. Find businesses without a listed website and review public contact details.
Find website redesign opportunities
Website Copyright search checks public websites for older copyright notices and business phone numbers. Copyright dates are prospecting signals, not proof of website age.
Organize leads and work together
Save named lead files, export CSV results, and share folders with your team. Mark leads complete and leave notes with author attribution.
₹100 Premium lifetime access

One payment unlocks both discovery methods for the operating lifetime of Heimdall. Google Places and Brave Search API fees are not included: Each API provider bills your account separately according to usage.

/google-places-setup.title: Connect Google Places API to Heimdall | Setup Guide
/google-places-setup.description: Set up Google Cloud billing, enable Places API (New), create and restrict your API key, and connect it to Heimdall. Understand separate Google usage charges.
/google-places-setup.heading: Connect Google Places.
sections: Create your Google Cloud project
Select or create a project in Google Cloud Console and link a billing account.
Enable Places API (New)
Enable Places API (New), create an API key, and restrict it to the required API and your server's outbound IP where appropriate.
Connect your key
Sign in to Heimdall, open Scrape → Google Places, and connect your key. The key stays in your backend session until sign-out or session expiry.
Monitor usage and billing
Google Places usage is billed separately by Google according to your usage. The ₹100 Heimdall purchase does not cover Google and Brave API fees.
